lemmas.primary_translation: to throw oneself about or twist one's body suddenly

definitions.text: slenge eller vri brått på kroppen
definitions.translation: to throw oneself about or twist one's body suddenly (lit. throw oneself)

examples.no: straks telefonen ringte kaster hun seg over den
examples.en: as soon as the phone rings, she throws herself at it

examples.no: han lå og kastet seg i sengen hele natten
examples.en: he lay tossing and turning in bed all night
the goalkeeper threw himself onto the ball
